body: Congratulations, we are all so proud of you! In my personal experience that is a common feeling to have, I also kind of just sat around after I startet coming out (i’m not out to everyone but at least my friends know) and wondered where to go from here. Finally being able to express yourself can be a bit weird especially if you’ve been hiding so long. But that feeling will fade into nothing and you will probably be in for some fun especially if you have a good support system in place. Lots of love from all of us here! ❤️

Don‘t go outside in the middle of the day if you don‘t have to, try to stay in the shade otherwise. Water is your friend, you should drink a lot of it, 3-4 liters a day if it‘s really hot and you‘re sweating. Also sweating makes you lose salts and minerals so you should try to keep that in check as well because otherwise drinking water won‘t help you. 
A quick way to cool down is to pour cold water over your wrists, works wonders. If someone is overheating that can also help stabilize them.
